_about: VG: the Twin Dial's layers and images per connection to cluster-render (R = 300 px). kind: effect (a shader layer, no pixel memory), sheet (an image layer packed by hud.js, RGBA8), scene (a baked texture sampled by a shader, an asset but not a layer: layer false), atlas (a glyph atlas, asset, layer false). Sizes in panel px; hypothesis until round 2 builds it. Read by tools/twin-dial/vg/budget.py.
